Name: Chubby Lung from Arknights
Author: EndlessPathB103
Description:
[i][b][font=Arial Black]可以去玛妮那里收养12只小笼泡宠物！它们会在一定的好感度给你对应的小笼泡美食，然后还有各种待机动作！
You can go to Marnie’s to adopt 12 Chubby Lung pets! At certain friendship levels, they’ll give you the corresponding Chubby Lung treats！

由于小笼泡们使用的是乌龟的变体，所以会替换乌龟的声音。
Since the Chubby Lungs use a variant of the turtle, they will replace the turtle’s sounds.[/font][/b][/i]

Manifest.Name: ChubbyLung小笼泡
Manifest.Description: 加入了非常可爱的小笼泡们！
